title: AI for Economics
description: AI as a research tool for modeling, simulation, forecasting, and analysis of economic behavior and economic systems.
intro: This track organizes work where AI primarily acts as a methodological instrument for economics research, spanning behavioral modeling, experiments, text analysis, causal evaluation, and forecasting.

readingPaths.title: Beginner route
readingPaths.label: Overview → methods → cases
steps: Read behavior modeling first to understand agent assumptions.
Then open experimental economics for validation settings.
Finish with forecasting or policy evaluation for applied perspectives.

readingPaths.title: Simulation-oriented route
readingPaths.label: Microfoundations → simulation → decision support
steps: Start from economic agent behavior modeling.
Move to causal policy evaluation for counterfactual analysis.
Use forecasting and measurement for real-time deployment thinking.

subcategories.title: Economic Agent Behavior Modeling
subcategories.description: How AI methods are used to model economic agents, bounded rationality, preferences, adaptation, and sequential decision processes.
recommendation: Then compare RL-based and LLM-based agents.
Track how behavioral assumptions affect simulation realism.

timeline.title: General equilibrium and empirical macro traditions
timeline.description: Aggregate structure, reduced-form relations, and calibration dominated early work.

timeline.title: DSGE and intertemporal microfoundations
timeline.description: Explicit dynamic decision structure and shock propagation became central.

timeline.title: Heterogeneous-agent and agent-based simulation
timeline.description: Distribution, interaction, and bottom-up emergence entered the mainstream.

timeline.title: RL and LLM agents
timeline.description: AI methods enabled adaptive policies, language-based reasoning, and richer social feedback.

papers.title: Curated Slot: RL-Based Household Decision Modeling
papers.abstract: Use this slot for papers that learn household savings, labor, or portfolio decisions with sequential optimization methods.

papers.title: Curated Slot: LLM-Based Crowd Behavior Simulation
papers.abstract: Use this slot for work on language-model agents, bounded rationality, social interaction, and alignment to real human behavior.

papers.title: Curated Slot: DSGE–AI Hybrid Behavioral Modeling
papers.abstract: Suitable for papers connecting economic structure with machine-learning-based policy functions or behavioral approximations.

subcategories.title: Experimental Economics Research
subcategories.description: AI agents and synthetic subjects in experimental economics, covering mechanism pretesting, participant simulation, human–AI / AI–AI games, and methodological evaluation.
recommendation: Start with the working definition and core criteria.
Then browse the six grouped sections from A to F.
Use keyword search and year filtering to locate specific papers.

subcategories.title: Economic Text Data Analysis
subcategories.description: NLP and LLM methods for extracting narratives, expectations, policy signals, and institutional knowledge from economic text.
recommendation: Begin with text representation and labeling choices.
Then compare narrative extraction with forecasting value.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Policy Communication Mining with LLMs
papers.abstract: Use this card for papers that interpret policy statements, speeches, or regulatory communication with modern language models.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Narrative Signals from Economic News
papers.abstract: Suitable for research on sentiment, topic dynamics, narrative shocks, and information transmission in economic text corpora.

subcategories.title: Causal Inference and Policy Evaluation
subcategories.description: AI-augmented methods for treatment effect estimation, counterfactual prediction, policy targeting, and structural policy analysis.
recommendation: Show where AI improves policy targeting or heterogeneity estimation.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Machine Learning for Heterogeneous Policy Effects
papers.abstract: Use this slot for studies combining causal estimation with flexible function approximation in policy analysis.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Counterfactual Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Suitable for papers on policy targeting, uplift modeling, robust off-policy evaluation, or structural counterfactual systems.

subcategories.title: Economic Forecasting and Measurement
subcategories.description: AI methods for macroeconomic nowcasting, market prediction, alternative-data measurement, and real-time indicators.
recommendation: Use this line for deployment-oriented research.
Compare timeliness gains with interpretability trade-offs.
Document how alternative data enters the pipeline.

papers.title: Curated Slot: AI for Macroeconomic Nowcasting
papers.abstract: Ideal for papers on mixed-frequency indicators, high-frequency macro signals, and flexible real-time forecasting systems.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Alternative Data for Economic Measurement
papers.abstract: Suitable for work that turns platform, transaction, text, or remote-sensing data into economic indicators.
